title: OpenMedConfig
description: OpenMedConfig and flat TOML profile settings.

default_org.description: Default organization on the Hugging Face Hub.

device.description: Device preference, such as cpu, mps, or cuda.

hf_token.description: Token for private models, when needed.

use_medical_tokenizer.description: Whether to use medical-aware output token remapping.

medical_tokenizer_exceptions.description: Terms kept intact during medical token remapping.

chinese_user_dict_path.description: Optional user dictionary for Chinese segmentation.

chinese_pkuseg_domain.description: Domain passed to the pkuseg Chinese segmenter.

clinical_protect_enabled.description: Whether clinical vocabulary protection is enabled.

clinical_protect_terms.description: Additional clinical terms protected from over-redaction.

clinical_protect_use_builtin.description: Whether bundled clinical protection terms are enabled.

backend.description: Inference backend; null selects automatic detection.

lazy_model_loading.description: Whether model loading is deferred until first use.

pii_model_revision.description: Optional revision for the profile-selected PII model.

onnx_intra_op_num_threads.description: Optional ONNX Runtime intra-op thread count.

load_in_4bit.description: Whether CUDA torch loads use bitsandbytes 4-bit quantization.

bnb_4bit_use_double_quant.description: Whether bitsandbytes 4-bit double quantization is enabled.

local_only.description: Whether inference and de-identification must remain cache-only.

cjk_width_convention.description: Width normalization convention for CJK text.

chinese_target_script.description: Optional target script for Chinese normalization.

transliteration_aware_name_matching.description: Whether Indic name matching links transliteration variants.

indic_name_similarity_threshold.description: Similarity threshold for transliteration-aware name matching.

profile.description: Name of a built-in or custom profile.
